messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU host node-ax42 experienced 3 container restarts in 2m; reason: CUDA OOM during prefill. Severity: P2.
alice (eng-runtime): seeing increased prefill token sizes from a single tenant, long-chat sessions. telemetry shows spikes ~900k tokens/s on that node.
carla (oncall): paging oncall.jordan — can you take a look?
jordan (pager): on it, pulling logs.
ben (sre): joining. Any immediate customer impact?
devon (cust-ops): CSM pinged — one paying customer reported degraded responses and reconnects to chat. No SLA breach yet but noisy.
alice (eng-runtime): tail of container log: ```2026-03-18T23:40:12Z stderr: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
*** Aborted at 1679287212 (unix time) try "date -d @1679287212" ***
container exited with code 137```
jordan (pager): node shows GPU memory near 98% at crash, kvcache grew during prefill.
ben (sre): suggested mitigation: isolate node, cordon/drain, and shift traffic off noisy tenant. Can we route them to smaller model variant?
alice (eng-runtime): yes — we have a quantized-8b variant and a low-memory policy. I can flip routing policy to prefer quant-8b for that tenant and enforce prefill token cap at edge.
carla (oncall): do it. Also enable emergency throttle on that tenant for 10m.
devon (cust-ops): I'll draft a quick customer message: "We're investigating intermittent reconnects; temporary throttling may be applied to maintain availability."
alice (eng-runtime): applying routing change now: `POST /routing/policies` payload => {tenant: "T-9812", prefer: "quant-8b", prefill_max_tokens: 32768} 
ops-bot: deploy hook: routing policy update successful, version v2026.03.18-ctlr3.
jordan (pager): starting cordon: `kubectl cordon node-ax42` then drain with `kubectl drain node-ax42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
ben (sre): monitoring for repeat restarts. Setting node to isolated to prevent noisy neighbor from returning.
alice (eng-runtime): added KV cache trim rule for node-ax42: aggressive trim after prefill path to free memory.
devon (cust-ops): customer notified (short note). They asked if we have ETA for stable service.
carla (oncall): ETA 20–30m to validate stability after routing change and node recycle.
jordan (pager): node drained and rebooted; GPU process restarted cleanly. Observability: memory utilization dropped to baseline ~42%. No new OOMs in 6m.
ben (sre): :white_check_mark: mitigation holding. Recommend follow-ups: (1) permanent prefill token quota per-tenant, (2) circuit-breaker on long-prefill requests, (3) postmortem with threshold tuning.
alice (eng-runtime): I'll open an RFC for prefill circuit-breaker and add a monitor alert for kvcache growth >70% over 1m.
devon (cust-ops): CSM updated customer: temporary throttle removed, system normal. They asked for a root-cause note.
carla (oncall): closing this page for now; create incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6371000000. Links: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-6371000000
